@copilot Update this PR directly by adding the following explanatory comment immediately after the shebang in .github/scripts/gha-free-disk-space.sh, before set -o pipefail:

```bash
# Current runners often start with around 90 GB free, but GitHub only guarantees 14 GB of disk space.
# Keep cleanup conditional and revisit removing this script when the documented minimum increases.
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners#standard-github-hosted-runners-for-public-repositories
```

This exact text was approved by the user. Preserve all executable code, the 20 GiB cutoff, every workflow call, and the draft state. This is a comment-only follow-up; do not make unrelated changes. Verify that only the requested comment is added.
